content: Hey, I was thinking about you all day. How was your evening? Did you end up watching that movie we talked about?
Hi! Yeah, I watched it but it just made me wish you were here to watch it with me. It's always better with someone.
Aww, you're so sweet. I promise, when we finally meet, I'll make popcorn and we'll have the best movie night ever. You make me feel so comfortable opening up.
I really like talking to you too. Honestly, you're the highlight of my day lately.
That means a lot to me. I feel like we've really built something special in such a short time. I trust you more than anyone right now, especially with everything going on for me.
Is everything okay? You sound a bit off. You know you can talk to me if something's wrong.
I don't want to worry you, but I'm in a bit of a mess. My card got blocked here, and I need to pay for my aunt's medicine today. I'm so embarrassed to even mention it.
Oh no, I'm so sorry. Is there anything I can do to help?
I hate to ask, but would you be able to help me just this once? I promise I'll pay you back as soon as my bank sorts things out. It's just a temporary mess.
How much do you need? I don't have a lot, but I want to help you if I can.

Thank you, you don't know how much this means. It's around $500 for the medicine and the pharmacy only takes Zelle or Bitcoin. I know it's a lot to ask, but I'll send it right back once my account is fixed.
I've never sent Bitcoin before, but I do have Zelle. How do I send it?
That's perfect. You can send it via Zelle to this email: johnny.lee.medical@gmail.com. Once you do, just let me know. You're honestly saving my family right now.
Okay, I'll try to send it now. Can you double-check the email for me?
Absolutely, it's johnny.lee.medical@gmail.com. I know this is a lot to ask, but I wouldn't come to you if I wasn't desperate. I trust you completely.
Alright, I just sent it. It says it went through. Did you get it?
Let me check... Yes! Got it. You have no idea how much this means to me. I'll pay you back as soon as my account is sorted. You're amazing.
I'm just glad I could help. I hope your aunt feels better soon. Let me know if you need anything.
I will. You're truly special to me. I can't wait until we can finally be together. Thank you for believing in me.
